results.evidence: The EventError docstring now says it covers time and cost entries (validate_time, validate_cost, void_entry, R-30). Those functions do raise EventError (events.py:569-611, 681-695). The CLI log-time/log-cost path catches events.EventError, prints 'error: <exc>' and returns EXIT_REFUSED (cli.py:676-678, 694-696). EXIT_REFUSED = 1 (cli.py:39). The docstring's other claims also hold: validate_correction and log_correction raise it (events.py:399-458), hand_review raises it (hand_review.py:59-119), and the CLI catches it with the same message and exit code (cli.py:494). The existing refusal tests in tests/test_time_cost.py assert exit 1 and the 'error:' prefix (test_bad_hours_are_refused, test_bad_amounts_are_refused, test_void_refusals_write_nothing). All 56 tests in that file pass.
